units.source_text: 然而，这里又轮到白子先手。

en.t: Yet here it was White's turn to move first again.

units.source_text: 名人满脸严肃的表情，他合上眼睛，静静地调整了呼吸。

en.t: The Master wore a grave expression over his whole face; he closed his eyes and quietly steadied his breathing.

units.source_text: 不知什么时候，红润的脸变成了紫铜色，脸颊上的肌肉忒忒地抽动。

en.t: At some point, his ruddy face had turned a purplish bronze, and the muscles in his cheeks twitched spasmodically.

units.source_text: 他仿佛连风声和法华大鼓声都听不见。

en.t: He seemed unable to hear even the sound of the wind or the great Hokke drum.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，这一手，名人也用了四十七分钟。

en.t: Even so, the Master spent forty-seven minutes on this move as well.

units.source_text: 这是名人在伊东唯一的一次长考。

en.t: This was the Master's only long deliberation at Ito.

units.source_text: 轮到黑109，大竹七段又用了两小时四十三分钟，最后封盘。

en.t: When it came to Black 109, Otake 7-dan again used two hours and forty-three minutes, and finally sealed the move.
That day, only four moves were played.

units.source_text: 七段用时三小时四十六分，名人仅仅用时四十九分。

en.t: The 7-dan used three hours and forty-six minutes, while the Master used only forty-nine minutes.
